bio.text: Dave Dawson, a Democrat and former state representative, won the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary for Iowa's open 4th Congressional District seat, according to KTIV.

According to Iowa Public Radio, he is a lawyer who served two terms in the Iowa House, lost a 2018 Iowa Senate race, and spent 20 years as a prosecutor in the Woodbury County Attorney's Office in Sioux City.
He was born in Cherokee, spent his formative years in Washta, earned his undergraduate degree at Iowa State University, and lives in Lawton with his wife and three children.

sources.title: A former Democratic state lawmaker touts his service and experience as he eyes a Congress seat
